record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.context_brief: Thomassen partition with prescribed small set
record.original_question: For every positive integer l, does there exist an integer k(l) such that whenever G is a k(l)-connected graph and X is a subset of V(G) with |X| <= l, the graph G has a partition (S, T) with X contained in S, every vertex of S having at least l neighbors in T, and both induced subgraphs G[S] and G[T] l-connected?

evidence.quote: K¨uhn and Osthus’ theorem is a step toward to a very hard conjecture of Thomassen [63].

Conjecture 4.2[63] For every integer l, there is an integer k = k(l) such that if G is a k-connected graph and X ⊆ V (G) with |X| ≤ l, then G admits a partition (S, T ) such that X ⊆ S, each vertex in S has at least l neighbors in T and both G[S] and G[T ] are l-connected.
Little is known about this conjecture.

artifact.status_search_result: Web searches indicate that this conjecture of Thomassen (with the prescribed-set strengthening of partitioning a highly connected graph into two highly connected parts where vertices of one part have many neighbors in the other) remains open. Related results — Kühn–Osthus on highly connected spanning bipartite subgraphs, Stiebitz's degree-partition theorem, and tournament analogues — represent progress on neighboring questions, but the specific graph version with prescribed X ⊆ S does not appear to have been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Highly Connected Graphs Have Highly Connected Spanning Bipartite Subgraphs
status_evidence.snippet: Thomassen asked whether there is a function f(k) such that every f(k)-connected graph admits a spanning bipartite k-connected subgraph; related to but weaker than the partition conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: A closely related Thomassen conjecture on highly connected spanning bipartite subgraphs is still being actively studied, with only bounds (not exact answers) known.

status_evidence.title: On a Conjecture of Thomassen
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of Thomassen's vertex partition conjectures showing partial progress on the connectivity-partition problem.
status_evidence.claim: Work on Thomassen's vertex partition conjectures has produced partial results but the prescribed-set version remains unresolved.
